mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact lets a Task list its own owner in shared_with; the injection forces such a Task to exist, which NoSelfMutation should catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnerSelfShare { some t: Task | t.owner in t.sharedWith }

mutation_targets.rationale: without this fact, sharees can be from a foreign team; the injection forces a cross-team sharee, violating FR-012.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamSharee { some t: Task | some s: t.sharedWith | s.userTeam != t.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact lets a successful Action target a task in a different team; the injection makes such an Action exist, violating cross-team isolation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamAccess { some act: Action | act.outcome = OK and act.caller.userTeam != act.target.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact lets the audit entry record a role that doesn't match the actor's persisted role (i.e., role taken from request body); the injection forces a misattributed entry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMisattribution { some a: AuditEntry | a.auditActorRole != a.auditActor.userRole }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact allows an AuditEntry to exist without any producing Action (orphan or fabricated); the injection forces such an orphan, which AppendOnly should reject.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OrphanAudit { some ae: AuditEntry | no act: Action | ae in act.produces }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing the access-matrix definition lets Alloy populate forbidden cells; the injection forces (TeamAdminRel -> PatchTaskShare) to be allowed, which directly violates the FR-005 / FR-010 invariant that share-list changes are owner-only.
removing this fact allows a successful mutation Action to produce zero audit entries; the injection forces such an Action to exist, violating per-event audit completeness.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoAuditOnMutation { some act: Action | act.outcome = OK and act.kind = PatchTaskFields and no act.produces }
